source.name: Strathclyde Partnership for Transport (SPT) - Subway tickets and fares
source.notes: Adult Smartcard fares effective 5 January 2026 (SPT notice of 19/12/2025: https://www.spt.co.uk/about-us/news/subway-fares-revised-for-2026/). SPT publishes no student or young-person Subway fare; students are therefore priced at adult fares. The tickets page lists GBP 60 for the 28-day ticket (station price); the notice gives GBP 55 when bought online.

smartcard_note: Personalised Smartcard registered online. Required for season tickets.

timing_estimate.notes: Secondary source (not SPT). In-train time is estimated as 24/15 = 1.6 minutes per station-to-station segment, plus an average wait of half the 4-minute peak headway. These are estimates, not timetable data.
